posts.title: Improving in chess is hard. I built the world's most human-like chess AI to help me.
posts.description: Getting better at chess is really hard . My theory is that it’s at least partially because of the feedback lag. Imagine learning to play the violin, but you have to play each song with earplugs in, then listen to the recording after. This is roughly what chess learning feels like, outside of focused drills. posts.title: An honest review of my last year building Chessbook
posts.description: Last year, I quit my job to work full-time on a chess app I created. It’s my first time working full-time on a project of my own, and it’s been both terrifying and gratifying.
